definitions.explanation: Language as used in writing, as opposed to spoken language. Encompasses the vocabulary, grammar, and style characteristic of written communication.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}→話し言葉：23878_hanashikotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Written language and spoken language are different.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漢語|かんご}→漢語：13439_kango⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese written language contains many Sino-Japanese words.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固|かた}すぎる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧にしましょう。
examples.english: This expression is too stiff as written language, so let's use a softer way of saying it.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (writing) and ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (language; words). In Japanese, the gap between written and spoken language is significant. Written Japanese tends to use more Sino-Japanese compounds (⟦{漢語|かんご}→漢語：13439_kango⟧), longer sentences, and formal grammar, while spoken Japanese uses more native Japanese words (⟦{和語|わご}→和語：12074_wago⟧), contractions, and casual forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}→話し言葉：23878_hanashikotoba⟧: written and spoken language
- {書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: written expression
- {書|か}き{言葉|ことば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in written-style language

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}→話し言葉：23878_hanashikotoba⟧: spoken language — the counterpart to {書|か}き{言葉|ことば}
- ⟦{文語|ぶんご}→文語：12991_bungo⟧: literary language — specifically the classical written style, as opposed to modern written Japanese
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧: colloquial language — modern spoken style, often contrasted with ⟦{文語|ぶんご}→文語：12991_bungo⟧
